crossRefs.note: A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.
Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give…
But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.
Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!
For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that…
Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be…

translations.web: Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.
translations.bsb: Do not wear yourself out to get rich; be wise enough to restrain yourself.
translations.kjv: Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom.
translations.asv: Weary not thyself to be rich; Cease from thine own wisdom.
